The decision often starts too narrowly

The first conversation should not become the only option.

Hotel opportunities are often shaped through existing relationships, individual presentations, and sequential conversations. Valuable alternatives may remain unseen until momentum has already formed around one path.

  • Credible alternatives remain unexplored.
  • Proposals are evaluated on different assumptions.
  • Negotiating leverage declines as commitment builds.

A clearer path

See the opportunity before selecting the relationship.

Dealality brings the strategic possibilities, market engagement, proposal evidence, and decision criteria around one hotel opportunity into a structured process.

Built around the decision

One opportunity. One structured decision environment.

Strategic paths and shortlist reasoning

Clarify which brand, operator, conversion, or strategic-partner paths are realistic—and why—before outreach begins.

Comparable proposals and material trade-offs

Organize responses so economics, requirements, control, timing, and unresolved terms can be compared on a shared basis.

Negotiation priorities and decision rationale

Surface gaps earlier and preserve a clear record of why the selected path was chosen.

Confidential. Owner-led. Human-guided.

Important hotel decisions require more than software.

Dealality combines structured technology with hospitality judgment, owner-controlled participation, and selective information sharing. The owner determines which paths are explored, which parties are engaged, and what advances.

Confidential by design Sensitive information is organized and shared according to the needs of the process.

Owner-controlled The owner decides which paths are explored and which relationships advance.

Human-guided Technology supports research, organization, and comparison. Hospitality judgment remains central.

Dealality was developed from the realities of hotel brand, operator, development, conversion, and strategic-partner decisions, with the hospitality perspective of AO Hospitality Advisors.

— Joan DeJarden, Founder
